title: Access pillar '已分配用户' counts only DIRECT grants — holders via position bindings show as 0 人
body:
Dogfooding the Access pillar (permission matrix) as a business admin on a live showcase boot:

1. Bind `showcase_contributor` to the `contributor` position (`sys_position_permission_set`, 201).
2. Assign a user to `contributor` (`sys_user_position`, 201).
3. Reload the pillar → the set's 已分配用户 footer still reads **0 人 /「还没有分配任何用户」**.

The count evidently reads `sys_user_permission_set` (direct grants) only. In the ADR-0090 model positions are THE distribution channel — direct grants are the exception — so for any normally-administered set the footer permanently shows 0, and an admin auditing "who holds this?" is told *nobody* right before they edit or delete a set that a whole position's population depends on.

## Suggested shape

Count (and list) effective holders = direct grants ∪ holders of every position bound to the set (`sys_position_permission_set` → `sys_user_position`), with a per-row via badge (直授 / via 岗位 X) — same attribution vocabulary the explain panel already uses. The blast-radius sentence in framework's access-matrix drift output ("~N users") wants the same resolution.
